<!--  PASSWORD SCRIPT                                  -->
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
// SHA-256 hash of the access password (current: "FBE2026").
// To change: run  echo -n "NewPassword" | sha256sum  and replace the string below.
const CORRECT_HASH = "8336c228b3c1c4db29fef17da5fd06a7088c9f02819c35395a4dde8e1e181bc3";

async function sha256(message) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(message));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

async function checkPw() {
  const hash = await sha256(document.getElementById("pw-input").value);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("course-content").style.display = "block";
    sessionStorage.setItem("fbe_unlocked", "1");
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(() => { err.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
  }
}

if (sessionStorage.getItem("fbe_unlocked") === "1") {
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("course-content").style.display = "block";
}
</script>
